research_scope: Ten base-game skills from PQ71-PQ80. Reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

duplicate_check.repository_search_note: All ten selected names returned no repository-search matches before insertion.

verification_audit.research_update: Counter Burst was promoted to verified_current_scope after current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent technique documentation confirmed its 100-Ki Ki Blast Super identity, six-hit counter projectile, PQ75 endpoint, and SSGSS Vegeta customization context; reward probability and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved. Last Emperor was promoted to verified_current_scope after current Xenoverse 2-specific and independent evidence corroborated its 0-Ki Ultimate identity, low-health/single-use restriction, and PQ71 provenance; exact reward probability and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Last Emperor
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form); Frieza (Full Power); Golden Frieza; Golden Frieza (Supervillain)
records.skill_description: Fires a powerful purple energy wave without using Ki, but can only be used once when the user's health is low.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence confirms Last Emperor as a 0-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. It can be activated only at low health and only once per battle; independent discussion distinguishes it from Emperor's Death Beam and corroborates the no-Ki/low-health restriction. Repository skill-specific evidence retains the 21-hit beam note. PQ71 remains the acquisition endpoint; TP Medal Shop and 1st Form Frieza Partner Customization are documented in current skill provenance, but no exact reward probability or Ultimate-Finish-only requirement is inferred.

records.name: Burst Kamehameha
records.character_source: SSGSS Goku; Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4)
records.skill_description: Fires a Kamehameha and can consume additional Ki through a second input to extend the blast and deal more damage.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Burst Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Super. Initial activation uses 100 Ki; an additional input consumes another Ki bar for the extended attack.

records.name: Psychic Move
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 73 — Frieza's Siege Against Earth!
records.skill_description: An evasive teleportation technique that repositions the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill data and the character-ID reference classify Psychic Move as an Evasive skill usable by CaCs. The accessible sources used here do not establish a sufficiently reliable stamina cost, so it remains unresolved.

records.name: Final Pose
records.mechanics_notes: The character-ID reference identifies Final Pose as a CaC Evasive skill. Exact stamina cost and detailed effect were not promoted without a sufficiently direct current technical source.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.skill_description: Counters an incoming Ki Blast and returns a more powerful Ki Blast to the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation confirms Counter Burst as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. It projects an energy shield that absorbs an incoming Ki Blast attack and returns a stronger Ki Blast counter; current skill data documents a six-hit counter projectile. PQ75 is the CaC acquisition endpoint, and current documentation also records Partner Customization availability for SSGSS Vegeta.

records.name: Warp Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku; Goku (Super Saiyan God); SSGSS Goku; Goku (GT); Goku (Super Saiyan 4); Cell (Perfect); Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4); Goku Black; SSGSS Vegito; SSGSS Gogeta
records.skill_description: Charges a Kamehameha, teleports to the locked-on opponent, and fires at close range.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Warp Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 400 Ki and documents teleport/tracking behavior. An older reference lists 300 Ki; the current skill-specific value is retained while the discrepancy remains provenance.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.skill_description: Releases an explosive burst of Ki around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: The maintained skill-category references classify Ki Explosion as a Ki Blast Super and the character-ID reference marks it as CaC-usable. Exact PQ reward-slot semantics remain unresolved.

records.name: Dust Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 78 — Heated, Furious, Ultimate Battle
records.skill_description: A dust-based technique used to obscure or interfere with the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent Future Warrior technique references classify Dust Attack as one of Piccolo's Super Skills and the character-ID reference marks it CaC-usable. Exact resource cost is left unresolved.

records.name: Mighty Explosive Wave
records.skill_description: Unleashes an explosive Ki wave around the user.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-category references classify the base-game Mighty Explosive Wave as a Ki Blast Super. A separate later Evasive Mighty Explosive Wave exists for Jiren (Full Power); this record is specifically the PQ79 base-game Super Skill.

records.name: Dimensional Hole
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest!
records.skill_description: Creates a dimensional hole that absorbs a normal Ki Blast and sends a projectile back through a portal behind the opponent.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Dimensional Hole as a Ki Blast Super with 0 Ki. It functions as a counter to basic Ki Blast attacks and launches the returned projectile behind the opponent.
